retry-model-busy.description: The first /v1/ocr call answers 503 model_busy with retryAfterMs 1200. A client waits at least 1.2 s and repeats the call with the same Idempotency-Key; the second attempt succeeds.

rate-limited.description: The first two /v1/segment calls answer 429 rate_limited with retryAfterMs 0 (Retry-After: 1). A client waits at least 1 s each time and succeeds on the third attempt.

not-retryable.description: The first /v1/ocr call answers 502 bad_model_output (retryable false). A client raises a typed error at once, without repeating the call.

image-evicted.description: The second /v1/ocr call finds every stored image evicted and answers 404 image_not_found. A client that uploaded the image uploads it again and repeats the call once.

batch-partial.description: A batch of 4 or more items: item 1 fails with bad_model_output, items from index 3 expire. A client records items 0 and 2 in the ledger, item 1 as an error and items 3+ as expired.

free-busy.description: Free tier (no key): the first /v1/ocr call answers 429 free_busy with retryAfterMs 1200. A client waits at least 1.2 s and repeats the call; the second attempt succeeds.

free-daily-limit.description: Free tier (no key): the first /v1/ocr call answers 429 daily_limit_reached. A client does not repeat the call and raises a typed error whose message points to FOLDBUN_API_KEY.

free-unavailable.description: Free tier (no key): the first /v1/ocr call answers 403 free_tier_unavailable. A client does not repeat the call and raises a typed error whose message points to FOLDBUN_API_KEY.

free-remaining-zero.description: Free tier (no key): the first /v1/ocr answer carries X-RateLimit-Remaining 0 and X-RateLimit-Reset 1. A client sends the second call at least 1 s after the first.

batch-dropped.description: The event stream of the first batch closes after 2 items without a summary. Repeating the batch with the same Idempotency-Key replays the finished items (replayed: true, not charged) and runs the rest.

job-partial.description: A job of 4 or more items: the first poll sees it running with part of the items done, the second sees it completed; item 1 fails with bad_model_output. A client reads the results by cursor, records the ok items in the ledger once and counts the failed one as an error.

job-too-many.description: The first POST /v1/jobs answers 429 too_many_jobs with retryAfterMs 1200. A client waits at least 1.2 s and repeats the request with the same Idempotency-Key; the second attempt creates the job.
